result.title: Differentiable Exact Learning
result.summary: We introduce a framework for differentiable exact learning that couples an unbounded external environment to a state-tracking neural controller, which we train on policy-trajectory observations (PTOs): expert behavior traces that expose observations and actions while hiding internal states. In addition to the learning framework, we introduce Differentiable Finite-State Transducers (DFSTs) which use multilinear updates, support log-parallel training, and emulate arbitrary finite-state controllers, yielding computational universality through environmental interaction. From tiny training datasets, compact DFSTs achieve extreme length generalization on arithmetic and universal-simulation tasks. We replicate the success of DFSTs on RNNs and GRUs, thereby supporting a broader learning recipe: State-Tracking Controller + Unbounded External Environment + PTOs = Extreme Length Generalization. Beyond length generalization, our metric-extraction protocol recovers interpretable discrete controllers from trained DFSTs, which we prove equivalent to the target arithmetic and universal-simulation algorithms. Furthermore, for our Softmax DFST models, simply taking $\mathrm{argmax}$ over the transition probabilities yields discrete controllers which provably exactly perform universal Turing-machine simulation and binary arithmetic. Proving exact learning for the neural controllers requires assumptions, which we empirically support. We make our code, training recipes, model weights, and proof checkers publicly available at https://github.com/fanagor/DEL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出可微精确学习框架，将无界外部环境与状态跟踪神经控制器耦合，用策略轨迹观测训练，并引入支持 log-parallel 训练、可模拟任意有限状态控制器的可微有限状态转换器（DFST），在算术与通用模拟任务上实现极端长度泛化，还能从训练模型中提取可解释的离散控制器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式状态跟踪、极端长度泛化与潜在状态离散化提取，可能为 LVR 关注的状态抽象、组合泛化与 latent 可解释性核查提供方法线索，但材料无视觉或推理模态，需核查迁移可行性。
